A rotary encoder, counted by the chip

Two WebAssembly modules in one tab. The emulator runs real ESP32-C6 firmware; ky040.wasm — built from examples/parts/ky040 — models a KY-040 knob on GPIO 5, 6 and 7. Turn it and the chip's pulse counter counts four a detent, through the stock esp_driver_pcnt.

Pick the two files this page runs. The firmware is test_apps/pcnt_encoder built for esp32c6 (its merged flash image); the part is ky040.wasm, built from examples/parts/ky040.
